title: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in Los Angeles | 1970
content:
Bag One, John Lennon’s exhibition of erotic lithographs, opened on 1 March 1970 in Los Angeles, USA.

The lithographs, known collectively as Bag One, had been drawn by Lennon in 1969, and chronicled his wedding ceremony and honeymoon with Yoko Ono, and one of their bed-ins for world peace.

The Bag One Portfolio was published as a limited edition of 300, and contained 14 artworks. Similar exhibitions had opened in London (15 January), Detroit (21 January), Long Beach (28 January), New York City (7 February), Amsterdam (7 February), San Francisco (13 February), Toronto (14 February), and Milan (20 February).

The LA exhibition ran from 1-7 March 1970 at The Graphic Art Galleries on Westwood Boulevard.
